# Zoom Build Platform

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

The Zoom Build Platform is a suite of Communication Platform as a Service (CPaaS) products built on a cloud-based architecture. It's designed for video, engineered for reliability, and optimized for scalability. The platform includes:

-   **[Video SDK](/docs/video-sdk/)** for building custom video applications powered by Zoom's core technologies, featuring HD video and audio
-   **[Cobrowse SDK](/docs/cobrowse-sdk/)** for secure, real-time web collaboration with data masking, allowing customers to share their screen with service agents without exposing sensitive information
-   [**QSS for Video SDK**](/docs/api/qss/#tag/video-sdk-sessions) for details about network traffic in near real-time
-   [**AI Services**](/docs/ai-services/) for integrating intelligence APIs that support common workloads, enable media processing, and power customized solutions

_See the [Zoom Build Platform Developer plan](https://zoom.us/pricing/developer) for pricing._
